messages:
Maria: Quick check — PR #4821 is up for security review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4821. It changes the on‑prem auth handshake (adds REDWOOD_ONPREM_PROXY), switches the service token storage to Vault with an HSM-backed KMS provider for customers who enable it, and adds an egress rule for license/license-mgmt traffic. Need to know if anything here is blocking before I schedule a merge window.
Sam: High level q — is the service token ever written to disk or logs during startup/rotate? also what attack surface does the new proxy create? :eyes:
Maria: No disk writes, token is persisted only in Vault (lease TTL + renew). For on‑prem we use the pluggable KMSEngine interface so customers can supply an HSM provider; code adds a small adapter but keeps default behavior for hosted. Example config in PR:```yaml
onprem:
  enabled: true
  egress_cidr: "10.8.0.0/16"
  kms_provider: "hsm:pkcs11"
  secrets_backend: "vault"
```
Jess: The outbound change needs SOC signoff if we're opening egress to customer CIDRs. Which destinations/ports are required?
Maria: Only TLS 443 to license.example.com and tls to metrics.redwood-inference.com for telemetry (both via hostname). The egress CIDR is configurable per-customer; default shown above. We also have a strict allowlist for hostnames in the proxy.
Oliver: Quick privacy check — does the token carry any customer identifiers or PII? We should add a short privacy note to the PR and ops runbook about the token lifecycle and rotation cadence.
Maria: Token is machine auth only (no PII). Rotation/leases are configured: 7d TTL with automatic renew on active sessions; fallback manual rotate documented. I added unit tests for renew flow.
sec-bot: automated-scan: no hard-coded secrets detected in diff. dependency-check: flagged `pkcs11` adapter (low severity).
Sophia: LGTM from infra side modulo SOC/evidence of restricted egress. When are you planning to merge? I can reserve a Thurs merge window next week if that helps.
Maria: Thurs works for us. Tagging @Diego for final KMS/HSM review before we lock it.
Diego: Quick glance — adapter looks sane. Please add one integration test that exercises HSM fallback and a short ops note for manual rotation if the KMS provider is unreachable (steps + contact). After that +1 from sec.
Maria: Will add the integration test and runbook snippet this afternoon and update PR. Thanks all :thumbsup: I'll hold merge until Diego + SOC confirm, and then slot for Thurs.
